shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' /home/user/workspace/.agents/skills/mempal-memory/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "Rust toggl-cli entry invoice monthly billable time calendar month invoice rule" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,300p' src/commands/report.rs && printf '\\n--- list ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' src/commands/list.rs && printf '\\n--- models ---\\n' && sed -n '1,280p' src/models.rs"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/commands/mod.rs && printf '\\n--- cargo ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' Cargo.toml && printf '\\n--- tests utils ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' src/commands/test_utils.rs"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"MockApiClient|Mock.*Client|get_time_entries_filtered\" src/commands src | sed -n '1,180p'; rg -n \"normalize_time_entry|parse_datetime\" src/utilities.rs src -g '*.rs' | tail -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt && cargo test && cargo clippy -- -D warnings'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs'
/bin/bash -lc "cargo fmt --check && cargo test commands::invoice_monthly && git diff --check && git status --short && nl -ba src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-invoice-monthly.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Monthly invoice aggregation

Invoice-style monthly summaries filter to stopped billable entries, round each entry independently up to a 15-minute billing unit, and aggregate by the UTC calendar month of each entry's start. A sorted map keeps month output and the grand total deterministic; no qualifying entries use an explicit no-data result.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'

/bin/bash -lc "mempal search \"toggl-cli invoice-monthly JSON months total_billable_seconds\" --json --top-k 5 && sed -n '1,180p' src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs && sed -n '145,185p' src/arguments.rs && sed -n '245,275p' src/main.rs"
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt && cargo test commands::invoice_monthly && cargo build'
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt --check && cargo build && cargo test --no-run && cargo test --lib'
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo run --quiet -- entry invoice-monthly --help && git diff --check && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-invoice-monthly-json.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Monthly invoice JSON output

The monthly invoice machine-readable form mirrors the human aggregation with a top-level "'`months` array and `total_billable_seconds`. Each month uses `month` and integer `billable_seconds` fields in chronological order, and empty results serialize as an empty array with a zero total.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
